_doc: Ensembl 116 FASTAs (ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-116/fasta/homo_sapiens/dna, the unmasked 'dna' files). Applied by pipeline/run_recipes.py. Ensembl replaces IUPAC codes with N. Names: chromosomes by GRC Sequence-Name (1..22, X, Y, MT), scaffolds by GenBank accession. Order: chromosomes by name as text, then the scaffolds longest first. Two pairs of scaffolds tie on length (1,428 bp: KI270340.1 before KI270338.1; 1,048 bp: KI270335.1 before KI270378.1). Name order explains one and not the other, AGP order neither, so the observed order is listed explicitly. Toplevel lists the chromosomes in karyotype order (1..22, X, Y, MT), not by name, and adds the alts and patches (named by GRC Sequence-Name), as one block after the chromosomes, longest first, before the scaffolds; it leaves out the 3 patches placed on alt scaffolds (KN538374.1, MU273354.1, MU273386.1), hence placed_on: chromosome.
